request: Replace recurring paid AI title drafting with the owner's daily in-thread editorial review and save API credit for other uses
scope: Title drafting and its second-pass verification and queued-card retries only
changes: Title editor is an identity operation by default, with no request, cache callback or clock work
Queued editorial retries stop before Slack reads, AI requests, message updates and persistence
Central Slack delivery explicitly disables the editor and no longer receives OPENAI_API_KEY
Manual paid diagnostic is disabled by default and guarded before any credentials or network use
Existing offline editor tests opt in only with mocked requests
Daily in-thread editorial review remains the replacement; original wording may be visible between daily runs
preserved: All other existing AI workflows and their budgets and secrets
Source, validity, alcohol, deduplication and human Slack approval checks
Persistent approved live title edits, original evidence and all public deal data
Ordinary validated new-deal delivery to Slack
verificationPolicy: Offline request spies and a diagnostic-only Actions workflow with the live AI step skipped. No paid API or real Slack delivery run for testing.
limitations: No fixed monetary saving claimed; avoided requests depend on the number of new drafts and retries
Other AI workflows may still consume OpenAI API credit
Already-running jobs checked out before the change may retain old behavior; spent usage is not reversible
The daily local review depends on the Mac being awake and the desktop app running and uses the signed-in app account's usage limits
